name: biset mediator
description: The blind DIDComm mediator: who may open an inbox, how much it holds, how fast it answers

registration.open.description: Off: no new device inbox is opened (existing ones keep working).

registration.newInboxesPerAddressPerHour.description: Inboxes one client address may open in an hour (the Tor entrance has ten times as many, being one address for all its visitors).

limits.maxInboxes.description: The mediator opens no new inbox once it keeps this many.

limits.requestsPerMinute.description: Requests one client address may make in a minute (HTTP POST and WebSocket messages); more are answered 429.

limits.maxQueueItemsPerInbox.description: Messages waiting in one inbox; a full inbox takes no more.

limits.maxQueueBytesPerInbox.description: Bytes waiting in one inbox. Not below the largest message (1 MiB).
